_readme: Byline and author page for every Faith Library guide (rendered by scripts/build_site.py). The guides are credited to the team. To credit the real person who reviews each guide, fill in `reviewer` with details that person has agreed to publish; the build then names them in every byline and on /author/jesus-says-team/, and marks them up as the Article author (a schema.org Person with url and sameAs). Empty fields are not rendered.
name: the Jesus Says team
